versions.changelog:
Initial release: introduces a comprehensive, high-stakes de-escalation skill for handling anger across multiple contexts.

- Teaches exact, field-tested de-escalation protocols used by crisis professionals (hostage negotiators, police, customer service, mediators).
- Provides ready-to-use scripts, timing instructions, and non-verbal guidance for real-world situations: customer rages, family blowups, workplace outbursts, public confrontations.
- Includes step-by-step action sequences: Self-calibration, Physical & Vocal Anchor, Core De-Escalation, and Agreement/Exit Lock.
- Delivers scenario-specific edge-case handlers and logging instructions for agents.
- Emphasizes the power of active listening, strategic pauses, and emotional acknowledgment to calm tension and restore cooperation.
